item.title: #475: wire the M2 read-only and misc oracles into the differential tests
item.body:
Closes #475
Claim: ext/francoisgn-issue-475
Author model: Claude Sonnet 5.5

**Problem.** The 8 oracles of `Fixtures/M2-readonly` (R121a/b/c/e/f, R122a/c/d) and the `Fixtures/M2-misc` ones (R117a, R130a-c, #527) were outside the guard tests' case lists.

**What changed (tests and docs only, no parser change).**
- `TopicListDifferentialTests`: R121b/c/e/f and R117a join the list cases (per-case `folder`); R121a is a separate `wallMatchesOracle` test. `PrivateMessageBadgeParserTests` follows (R117a: badge 7).
- `MessageBlockOracleTests`, `TopicPageMetadataOracleTests`, `TopicPageFlagOracleTests`: R122a/c/d (M2-readonly) and R130a (M2-misc); the guards read the three maps.
- `HopFormOracleTests`: R130b (edit) and R130c (quote) via `Lot004FormOracle`.

**Differences from legacy (all justified in the specs).**
- R121a: legacy `noAuth` page, the port throws `.notAuthenticated` on the MP list URL (LOT-022 D1).
- R121e: legacy does detect polls here: the account is on the `defaut` theme and the rows carry `defaut/sondage.gif` (`ObjCTopicListParser.m:331` @ 2440d79). LOT-022 D5 amended; the test checks legacy's `isPoll` against the raw row.
- R122c: legacy prepends the "Voir ce message dans le sujet non filtré" link to `dicoHTML` (`ParseMessagesOperation.m:364-368` @ 2440d79); the port reads `div#para` only. LOT-030 difference 8.

**Tests shown to fail without the change** (mutate, run, restore): wall throw removed (R121a), poll detection off (R121c/e/f), badge reader returning 0 (R117a, R121e), red flag lost (R122a/c/d), search form dropped (R122a/c/d, R130a), `isDeleted` forced (all topic cases), CRLF prefill changed (R130c), strip of the search link removed (R122c), a case dropped from a list (coverage guards).

**Not in this PR.** R122/R130a are not added to the content, quote, actions and embed oracle suites (they read the LOT-003 map; outside the four guards of the issue).

---

**Adversarial review (Claude Opus 5.5, ext/francoisgn-issue-475-review, independent of the author): APPROVE** — head 8ab7415f7f961cf9335efbd5f2299a23e0572b23 The four findings below are Low or Nit. None of them blocks the merge. 1. **Low** — `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md:450` still says the M2-readonly oracles have "no Swift test reads them yet". After this PR that is false. Fix: say the LOT-002/003 differential tests read them (#475). 2. **Low** — `docs/lots/LOT-022-topic-list-parser.md:100` still lists "search results across categories (pivot shapes, E12)" under *Pending capture*. R121b and R121c are now captured and tested, and HFR-PROTOCOL.md:621 says "Pivot shapes captured". Fix: drop that item, or narrow it to whatever shape is still missing. 3. **Low** — `docs/lots/LOT-030-message-blocks.md:408` describes R130a as "MP thread, leading newline". In the corpus that body is replaced by "Private message content removed.", so no test checks the leading `\r
` (HFR-PROTOCOL.md:312 says so). Fix: add "(body redacted; leading newline not checked here)". 4. **Nit** — Two small points: - In `CaptureRowEvidence.swift:249`, `legacyPollPattern` accepts any host. Legacy matches the exact full URL `https://forum-images.hardware.fr/themes_static/images/defaut/sondage.gif` (`ObjCTopicListParser.m:331` @ 2440d79, `allowPartial:NO`). Anchoring the host would make the test evidence match what legacy really checks. - In `TopicPageFlagOracleTests.swift:156`, the continuation line of `overlap` is misindented. **Checked** - **Tests:** `swift test` on the head passes on Linux (1599 tests in 192 suites). `swiftlint --strict` on the changed files is clean. - **Mutation, filtered search (R122c):** making `filteredSearchCases` empty fails R122c (the search-link check plus 31 content-shape checks). - **Mutation, poll icon (R121e):** making `showsLegacyPollIcon` always false fails 8 rows of R121e. - **Legacy line citations:** the claims behind "difference 8" (`ParseMessagesOperation.m:364-368`) and D5 (`ObjCTopicListParser.m:331`) match 2440d79. - **R122c and R122d captures:** the cLink appears on R122c and not on R122d. - **Oracle values:** R121a is `noAuth` with no topics and `needToUpdateMP` false. R121e has `currentCat` "22" and `isPoll` on 8 of 53 rows. R117a has `currentCat` "11" and badge 7. R130b and R130c match the textarea contents in the LOT-036 claim. - **Coverage guards:** the guards now cover the M2-readonly and M2-misc maps. All 8 read-only cases (after R122b was removed) and the 4 misc ones from the issue comment are tested. W130 is out of scope. - **Other:** only test and doc files change, so there is no security surface, no module-boundary change and no change to production code. LESSONS rows 17, 18, 21, 35, 36, 51, 52 and 53 were checked. The `Closes #475` and `Claim:` lines match the active claim. The author model is Sonnet, so an Opus reviewer is correct. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
